content:
**Night Person** is a Perception-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Increased Intelligence and Perception between 6:00 p.m. and 6:00 a.m.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Gain +3 INT and +3 PER between the hours of 6:00 p.m. and 6:00 a.m. | 00188EFF | 
| ★★ | 2 | Gain +2 INT and +2 PER between the hours of 6:00 p.m. and 6:00 a.m. | 001D2495 | 
| ★ | 1 | Gain +1 INT and +1 PER between the hours of 6:00 p.m. and 6:00 a.m. | 0004C93B |
